lines: Ghazab kiya tere waade pe aitbaar kiya
couplets.en: What a foolish thing it was to trust your promise.

lines: Tamaam raat qayamat ka intezaar kiya
couplets.en: All night I waited for the world to end.
What a foolish thing I did.

lines: Ye dil ko taab kahaan hai ke ho maal-andesh
couplets.en: How could this heart bear to think of what might follow?

lines: Unhon ne waada kiya, is ne aitbaar kiya
couplets.en: You made a promise, and my heart believed you.
What a foolish thing I did.

lines: Hua hai koi magar uska chaahne waala
couplets.en: Someone must have fallen for the heavens.

lines: Ke aasmaan ne tera shewa ikhtiyaar kiya
couplets.en: Even the heavens have taken to your ways.

lines: Na poochh dil ki haqeeqat, magar ye kehte hain
couplets.en: Ask me nothing of my heart, though this much I will say.

lines: Woh beqaraar rahe jisne beqaraar kiya
couplets.en: May the one who robbed me of my rest lie restless too.

lines: Ghazab kiya tere waade pe aitbaar kiya
couplets.en: What a foolish thing it was to trust your promise.

lines: Tamaam raat qayamat ka intezaar kiya
couplets.en: All night I waited for the world to end.
What a fool I was over that promise of yours.
